heading: Monday
text: A few lingering showers northeast, another chance of mid-day showers, chance of flurries in the mountains. Highs from the mid to upper 50s, low 60 in the broad valleys and southeast. Light wind becoming northwest at 10 to 15 mph with 20 mph gusts.

heading: Monday Night
text: Partly cloudy. Much cooler. Lows in the mid to upper 20s. Northwest wind at 10 to 15 mph with 20 mph gusts.

heading: Tuesday
text: Mostly cloudy north, partly cloudy south. Much cooler. Highs in the low to mid 30s, nearing 40 in the warmer valleys.
